name: cyber-aware-creations
description: NIST-aligned cybersecurity skills for security leaders. Build, score, and maintain a risk register with change history and board dashboards; assess your program against the NIST CSF 2.0 as a tracked Organizational Profile with gap analysis and coverage reporting; and translate security facts into board-ready language with sourced regulatory receipts.

interface.shortDescription: NIST-aligned risk register, CSF 2.0 profile, and board translation
interface.longDescription: Three composable skills for the people accountable for security. Keep a NIST-aligned risk register that persists between sessions, with NISTIR 8286 event statements, deterministic Likelihood × Impact scoring and SP 800-30 banding, risk-appetite flagging, and an append-only change log. Track your programme against NIST CSF 2.0 as an Organizational Profile with computed gap analysis and coverage rollups. Translate any metric, risk, or quarter into board-ready language with sourced regulatory receipts. Everything runs locally against your own files. Not affiliated with or endorsed by NIST.
defaultPrompt: Import the gaps from my CSF profile, score them, and show me everything over appetite
Rate PR.AA-01 through PR.AA-06 for us, then snapshot the profile as our Q3 baseline
Our mean time to detect is 4.2 days, down from 9 last quarter. Make that board-ready
